precepts.label: Genesis 3:16
precepts.why:
“I will make him an help meet for him.” To help is to give assistance or support to someone, to provide something useful or necessary in achieving an end. Meet means suitable for him. So the help is the one who assists in making what the husband wants happen. Sometimes the help thinks she is supposed to lead, or thinks she is supposed to guide, but that is not what a help is.

Genesis 3:16 comes after the transgression: “thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.” Some have taken this to mean it was only at this point that the woman was supposed to listen to her husband. No. She was told she was the help back in Genesis 2; Genesis 3:16 confirms the rule after the fall.

So why do we feel today that being a help is a bad thing? Sisters, the help is the greatest thing you are ever going to be. The moment you decide being the help is not the greatest thing you can be, or think you are supposed to be something outside of the help, you are going to destroy your marriage.

It cuts both ways. Brothers, the moment you decide not to provide, not to leave the house and work, not to be the man God told you to be, watch what happens to your household: your marriage will crumble and your life will be in shambles. It is a domino effect. And headship is maintenance, a routine thing a husband has to keep doing. A wife will never say she is trying to overthrow you, but it is in her spirit, the same way a man wants to do things his own way when he gets orders from those ranked above him. So you will have to remind her: I am the head, you have to listen to me.

precepts.label: Isaiah 3:12
precepts.why:
Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. God made the woman “an help meet” for the man, and when that order is turned around, Isaiah 3:12 calls it what it is: “As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.”

That is a curse. It is not a good thing; it shows things out of order, not how God set it up. A woman's body alone shows she was not made to lead men into danger: her cycle comes, she is pregnant for nine months, and she is supposed to lead you somewhere?

Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. Some of you are scared to lead your house and have let her lead. If you are passive, scared, afraid of confrontation, she is going to walk all over you. It is not a secret; everyone sees it, and other men see it in your demeanor. You have to change the way you think. Stand up and take your place back.

The women were designed to be a help to their husbands. When they step outside of that, and when the brothers allow it, chaos follows. That is why there is dysfunction in our nation right now: because the men do not want to lead.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 31:22
precepts.why:
“How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.” A new thing: women being over men was never heard of. It is not natural, and it is not the natural state of a man to be run by a woman. But you allow it.

God did not set it up that way. In Genesis 2 he made the woman a help meet for the man. When she compasses him instead, the order is upside down.

Cases come up where a brother does not know what is going on in his own house. His wife pays all the bills while he is on the couch playing video games, and he cannot understand why his home is in confusion. It is because his wife is running things. She has been the breadwinner from day one, so she looks at it as normal, and he is used to it. He did not want a wife; he wanted a mama.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 34:31
precepts.why:
“And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.” The Lord uses men to lead. It has always been that way and it is never going to change. You will not change the order of things just because you are weak, or scared of your wife.

Sisters, the beta men on social media are influencing you, making you think the man is supposed to worship the ground you walk on. That will not influence the men in purple and gold. We are not worried about being called names, narcissist or misogynist. The question is, do you want a man or do you want a boy?

When your husband gets around the brothers and comes home acting different, he is supposed to. He examines himself, sees he is lacking, and comes home on fire to fix his house, with a little more pep in his step and a little more to say. The same goes when he has been rebuked for adultery or for not dealing with his wife the right way: he is supposed to move different. It works in every area if he truly believes.

This is why there is an attack on the household. Satan and his people know that to destroy us they have to attack our foundation, and the foundation is the home. Paul warned that in the last days perilous times would come, with those “Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof”, and “of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts.” They get in through the phone and the conversations, whoever is influencing them. We are building a nation, and if we are not strong on the home front, we will not get off the ground.

precepts.label: Proverbs 30:7-9
precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.” To see what that means, go to Proverbs.

“Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.”

Lest I be full and deny thee: that is one way of taking his name in vain. Lest I be poor and steal: that is sin, and sinning while bearing his name is taking the name of my God in vain. We are called by his name; he says we are a holy people, and he put his spirit in us.

So when they say you cannot keep the commandments, why can’t we? That does not mean we have never sinned. All men have sinned, and if anybody says they have not sinned, they lie. But when they say you cannot keep the commandments, it is because they want to remain in their sins.

This sits inside the first four commandments, which go into loving the Lord thy God. All of this blending of religions is meant to take you away from serving him and to keep you in sin.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 12:2
precepts.why:
Our commandment from our God was to destroy their altars, break their images and cut down their groves. A grove is trees, and they were cut down because they were sacred trees. Moses gives the same command in Deuteronomy: “Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods”. Destroy the places where the nations served their gods, wherever they are.

Watch where those places were: “upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree”. Not some trees. Under every green tree: evergreen, oak, cedar, palm, pine. Any place they served gods on a high mountain or a high hill, destroy it, and every place under a green tree, destroy it.

Read verse 3 and the command goes further: “And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire”. Burn the groves with fire. The Bohemian Grove, where most of the presidents, if not all of them, have gone, has an idol of Molech, the owl, standing under trees so tall all you see is the stalk. Don't focus on the owl; look at what surrounds it. The idol is under the tree. If we were in power today, that owl would be destroyed and those trees burned all around it. Burn it all.

That is why the tree matters for Exodus 34:13. The groves Israel was told to cut down are the trees the heathen worship under, and the tree set up in the house at Christmas is the same thing.

precepts.label: Hosea 4:13
precepts.why:
Hosea shows what went on under those trees: “They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms”. Oaks and poplars and elms are green trees, the same groves Exodus 34:13 says to cut down.

Why under the trees? “because the shadow thereof is good”. That owl in the Bohemian Grove sits under the shadow of those trees in the picture. The shadow of the tree is good to them because the idol is under the tree.

Then the fruit of it: “therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery”. Around that owl they visit, they do all kinds of sexual rituals; sexual things take place around that owl at Bohemian Grove. All the presidents, including Obama, who y'all love so much, went there, and who knows what was going on over there.

So the groves were not harmless. The worship under the green tree brings whoredom and adultery with it, and that is why God commanded Israel to cut them down.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 6:13
precepts.why:
Ezekiel names the same places: “upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols”. Under every green tree and under every thick oak, that is where they offered to their idols. Where did they sacrifice? Under the tree.

And God's judgment falls right there: “Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars”. The slain lie among the idols and around the altars under the trees.

Now see what the sacrifice is called. Matthew 5:23: “Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar”, and “Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift”. The gift is the sacrifice. Matthew 8:4 says the same: “offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them”. Moses commanded a gift, a sacrifice.

So when the heathen sacrificed under their tree, what was under the tree? Gifts. You don't put gifts on top of the tree, beside the tree, or hang them on the tree. You put them under the tree. That is where it comes from: the gifts under the Christmas tree are the heathen's offering to their idols under every green tree.

precepts.label: Isaiah 57:5
precepts.why:
Isaiah shows what else was under the tree: “Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?” What were they doing under the tree? Slaying the children. Those children were gifts too. The children were the gifts under the tree, slain under the tree.

That is why they use the children to allure us in all the most popular holidays, Halloween and Christmas. They use the kids.

And the alluring works through gifts. Ecclesiasticus 20:29: “Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove”. We have Google and technology; we can easily look it up and see that it is pagan. But we are so covetous and want that self-gratification: Thanksgiving gift, Valentine's Day gift, New Year's gift, Halloween gift, Christmas gifts, the Easter suit. The gifts stop up the mouth, so a man who knows it is wrong and evil will not say anything, and will even fight for it. Many black and brown men will battle for hours for Christmas because they are married and scared to lose a vagina. The woman got you by the balls, and she's got your balls under the damn tree, gift wrapped. You offered a gift.

You cannot make it good; it's evil. The tree and the gifts under it go back to the idols Israel was commanded to destroy, and celebrating it is celebrating the destruction of your own people with your family.

precepts.label: Hosea 2:8
precepts.why:
Judges says Israel “served Baalim” and “forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt”. Hosea shows how ungrateful that was: “For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.”

That is what the Lord did for Israel. He clothed us, gave us land, gave us food and possessions, all of that. And we turned around and prepared it for Baal; we started serving the devil with what God gave us. Baal, Baalim, it is the same thing: the Canaanite god of fertility, storms, thunder and lightning, worshipped in horrible ways, whose name means lord or master. He sounds like Thor. Baal and Ashtaroth have taken on so many names over the ages, which is why we rarely hear of them, but the worship is coming back to light.

Even now it goes on. Just days before this class, thousands of Afro-Brazilians gathered on a Rio beach to offer gifts to a sea goddess, Yemanja, revered in the Yoruba religion as the mother of all orishas and humanity. Brazil is the tribe of Asher. It is the same deity all throughout: “the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven”. Ashtaroth, the queen of heaven, Yemanja, whatever the name. Our people carried that witchcraft with them and kept doing it, even in Africa.

That's our history, and that is why we are in captivity today, catching hell. The Lord clothed us and named us, yet even in 2026 our people are still worshipping the devil, and we wonder why America goes down there stealing presidents, starving people out and destabilizing countries.

precepts.label: Leviticus 18:21
precepts.why:
“And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.” Molech worship went along with the fertility gods: it dealt with children, with the womb. That is what we were doing, and it is exactly what God told us not to do. We became bullheaded and stubborn and started worshipping the devil. That is how Israel “forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.”

Stubbornness runs through this whole history. “A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.” So we have to prophesy against the idolatry and come up out of this foolishness: Christmas, Valentine's Day, which a lot of our people celebrated. It has nothing to do with us. God did not give it to us.

“Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn”. That is why God's laws are taught without going to the left or the right: we know how we got over here, through stubbornness. If we want to be delivered, we have to wake up.

It is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” When there is no judge, no leader, in place, they go back to their lonesome: the officer's not here, the captain's not here, the Deacon's not here, the Bishop ain't here. If you can't uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, the same judgment is your future. Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Stubbornness is idolatry; it is satanic worship. So many think they are not dabbling in the mystic arts, but when you are stubborn and rebellious, you are: “sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone”.

thread.text: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings,

precepts.label: 1 Samuel 15:23
precepts.why:
Judges 2:19 ends: “they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal. 1 Samuel 15:23 says what stubbornness really is.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Bullheaded, stubborn, is idolatry. It is satanic worship.

That is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers.” Whenever there is not a judge, a leader, in place, they go to their lonesome. They get relaxed: the officer is not here, the captain is not here, the deacon is not here, the bishop ain’t here, let’s go back to our lonesome. If that is your spirit, you are going to get the same judgment. If you can’t uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, that is your future: damnation, judgment, destruction.

Ecclesiasticus 30:12, read just before, gives the remedy: “Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn.” That is why God’s laws are taught without going to the left or to the right, and without playing games. We know how we got over here: through stubbornness. So if we want to get delivered, we have to wake the hell up.

precepts.label: Revelation 21:8
precepts.why:
1 Samuel 15:23 said rebellion is as witchcraft and stubbornness is as idolatry. Revelation 21:8 shows where the witches and the idolaters end up.

“But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone.”

A lot of y’all think, I’m not dabbling in the mystic arts. Yes, you are. When you are stubborn and rebellious, yes, you are. It says sorcerers and idolaters. The one who in Judges 2:19 would not cease “from their stubborn way” is standing with the sorcerers and the idolaters, and their part is the lake of fire.

Psalms 78:8 makes the connection plain: “a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright.” “The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law.” That is the northern kingdom, though Judah did the same thing. Even when they got over here to the Americas they still did not keep the covenant, and that is why Assyria took the northern kingdom and why Columbus and Cortez came: because of the idolatry. The Lord was sick of it and still is, and this is the last time.

precepts.label: Tobit 4:12-13
precepts.why:
“But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh”. When you turn against the Lord in this, you turn against your neighbor too, because you are taking foreign women. We know it will turn your heart away from following the Lord, but what does it do to your brother? It says you hate your brother. Tobit shows it.

“Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”. He calls interracial marriage whoredom. “for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.”

“Now therefore, my son, love thy brethren, and despise not in thy heart thy brethren, the sons and daughters of thy people, in not taking a wife of them”. Don’t despise your brethren. Passing over the daughters of your own people for strange women is despising your brethren in your heart. “for in pride is destruction and much trouble, and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine.”

That is exactly where Solomon went. The Lord had said of those nations, “Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods”, and Solomon clave unto them in love. His wives turned away his heart after Ashtoreth, Milcom, Chemosh and Molech, and he built high places for them and for all his strange wives. That is how syncretism enters: through the strange wife, and it begins by despising your own people.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 35:1
precepts.why:
Solomon offered “according to the commandment of Moses”, on the sabbaths, the new moons and the solemn feasts, “three times in the year”: the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks and the feast of tabernacles. It is the same law given in Deuteronomy 16:16: “Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God”, and “they shall not appear before the Lord empty.” So we are supposed to gather and give an offering three times a year. We come together.

But do we give a physical offering today? No. So what do we offer? We offer ourselves; we offer obedience. Sirach puts it plainly: “He that keepeth the law bringeth offerings enough: he that taketh heed to the commandment offereth a peace offering.”

Keeping the law is the offering. The one who takes heed to the commandment is not coming before the Lord empty; his obedience is his peace offering. That is how Israel keeps these feasts now, the feast of weeks, which is Pentecost, among them: by gathering together and bringing a life that keeps the commandments.

precepts.label: Isaiah 46:9
precepts.why:
Babylon, “given to pleasures”, that “dwellest carelessly”, says in her heart, “I am, and none else beside me.” Where does she get that from? Isaiah 46 shows it: “Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me.”

That is what God says of himself, and Babylon says the exact same thing. America puts herself in the seat of God. You are a man, but if you want I will make you a woman; I can fix that, I made that happen. America is the land of entitlement and privilege. She does what she wants to others and to her own people: passes laws secretly, changes laws, raises prices and brings them down, puts people in office who do not belong there. She dwells carelessly, and she makes her citizens care less, read less, think less and do less.

That is blasphemy from Babylon’s mouth and actions. And our people share in it, because they cannot see a world without the white man ruling the planet. They say he has to be saved, because they cannot see Negroes ever ruling the earth; we can’t rule over ourselves without him. That is blasphemy, an insult to God: saying what God made cannot rule over its own people. You are in hell trying to give your oppressor a heaven.

But God alone is God, and the one who says “I am” in his place is brought down: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” The loss of children and widowhood come upon her “in a moment in one day”, “in their perfection”, every missile hitting its target as God intends, and her astrologers and prognosticators “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them.”

thread.label: Isaiah 47:1
thread.text: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

precepts.label: Psalms 137:7
precepts.why:
Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon? Let's identify her. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Destroy it, destroy it. Then, speaking to the same people: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. Edom is now called the daughter of Babylon, and she is destined to be destroyed.

So Isaiah 47 is the destruction of Babylon, which is Edom, the very thing David said in the psalm. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground”: you have been taken down, defeated. Then “there is no throne”: your throne is finished, your throne is over.

Then, “for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” Babylon calls herself tender and delicate. How? The United States of America says, we are a Christian nation. She has two horns like a lamb, Republicans and Democrats, and says, we are Christian, in God we trust. That is the tender and delicate virgin, and God says she will be called that no more.

The children of Edom who cried to raze Jerusalem to its foundation are the daughter of Babylon today, America, and she is the one who is to be destroyed.

precepts.label: Judges 16:21
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the daughter of Babylon, “Take the millstones, and grind meal”. What does that mean? When you take millstones and grind meal, you are working. But what kind of work? Look at what happened to Samson.

Samson listened to that woman called Delilah, who got paid to take his strength and destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite, and she gave it to him so good that he told her his secrets and went to sleep on her knees. The Philistines came in, cut his hair, bound him up and took his eyes out: “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

When it says they made him grind, they made him work. That is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: look up the 13th Amendment.

So this is what God is saying to America, to these Europeans, these Caucasians: take the millstones and grind meal. Get ready for slavery. Then “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” As a tender and delicate virgin her head was covered; God says uncover it, lift the dress to the calf, then to the thigh. The rivers she passes over are the word of God, “the washing of water by the word”. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show she is not, revealing her wickedness.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:16
precepts.why:
“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” How is America's nakedness uncovered? Through the prophets: the brothers on the streets, on YouTube, traveling, must uncover America's nakedness and reveal her wickedness. And Christ is not coming back as a man; he is coming back as God, because only a God can take down the United States of America. Russia can't do it, China can't do it. America has bases all over the world, and no other nation has that power.

Revelation 17 shows what happens to America and her allies: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” The ten horns on the beast with seven heads are NATO, the EU. They shall hate America, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire. That is the United States of America burnt up and destroyed.

Is America finished then? The party ain't over. 2 Esdras 15 says, “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” Not all of her is destroyed in that war. The country as we know it is finished, but America is not down yet, with all those bases everywhere.

That is why Isaiah says “I will not meet thee as a man.” The ten horns can make her naked and burn her, but the only one that can finally destroy America is God, Christ when he returns.

precepts.label: Romans 9:17
precepts.why:
The only one that can destroy America is Christ when he returns, and Romans 9 shows why God raised her up at all: “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.”

Pharaoh was over Egypt, and Egypt has long been destroyed. Pharaoh is a metaphor for Rome, and a metaphor for America today. Revelation calls the great city spiritually Sodom and Egypt, and that is Pharaoh right there.

God raised America up. Why? That he might show his power in her. All the technological advances America has, God allowed her to have. There is no nation, no country, that can match Babylon the Great; that is why they call it the great: it has the greatest technology of all nations. Christ says, I must show my power in you, because I am the only one that can take America out.

Then “and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” When Christ finally takes them down, his name shall be declared throughout all the earth, because we are going to declare his real name, his true name. That is the vengeance of Isaiah 47: “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

thread.label: Isaiah 47:6
thread.text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
“I was wroth with my people”: wroth means angry. The pictures of our people in slavery, beaten, on the slave ships, lynched, murdered from the time of slavery all the way up to now, are God being wroth with his people. It is like a family album of our family. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us, and we were made slaves for the white man.

Deuteronomy 28:48 is what that anger looked like: “he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Think about the mindset of the brother in those conditions, with the big yoke of iron on his neck and in the different positions of slavery. Your mind is going to go crazy, because you know you are not supposed to be in that situation. That is what those torture devices were set to do.

“until he have destroyed thee” means until your mind breaks down, until your manhood is gone and your ability to be free is gone. When you just succumb to being a slave, your mental strength and fortitude to be independent is broken. That is what black people are today.

So Isaiah 47:6 says the same: “thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” This Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy, and laid the yoke heavy even on the oldest among us. And she said “I shall be a lady for ever”, I will be Christian forever, and did not lay these things to heart, “neither didst remember the latter end of it”, though they have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end.

precepts.label: Colossians 2:8
precepts.why:
“I have polluted mine inheritance.” How did God pollute his people? With man-made religions. Paul warns: “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” None of these religions are after Christ.

Look at where they came from. Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, and after the popes the Protestants. John Smith created the Baptist religion. Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830. Ellen G. White created the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863. Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872. Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901.

These run from slavery up to 1863, when we so-called got emancipated, and on through Jim Crow and segregation. The same people who held us as slaves handed us these religions. What happened to John 3:16 and Galatians 3:28 while our people were in chains? They took that out of the Bible at that time.

So Isaiah 47:6 shows God allowed us to be polluted: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand.” The traditions of men that spoiled our people are part of that pollution, and that is why Christ is the enemy of Christianity.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:8
thread.text: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

precepts.label: Nahum 3:4
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly.” Given to pleasures: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, and it made negroes jealous and envious. “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am; they are setting themselves up as God on earth. “I shall not sit as a widow”: I will always have my allies. “neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: their citizens put to death, and their allies cutting them loose, “for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Their science and technology, like the mystery weapon that left Venezuelan soldiers bleeding through the nose, God calls witchcraft.

Nahum names her: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot is the same whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. She is well-favoured because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here; everybody says, I can get rich there.

She is called the mistress of witchcrafts. And in case you did not think it was America: “that selleth nations.” What nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. “and families through her witchcrafts”: did they not sell our families? You had better believe they did.

So the one given to pleasures who says I am, and none else beside me, is the harlot of Nahum. Her sorceries, labored in “from thy youth” since July 4th, 1776, are the reason the loss of children and widowhood will come upon her in one day.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:12
thread.text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:7
precepts.why:
“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is saying, Stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee”: their generals, admirals and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome and create this missile and that missile. “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”: burnt up, destroyed, by nuclear fire, by God’s fire. “there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: no comfort for Babylon.

Peter shows that fire: “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire, and the perdition of ungodly men is Christianity and whatever other little religions are here.

The scoffers say, “Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” They purposely ignore the flood of Genesis 6, when God killed everybody on the planet except eight people: “For this they willingly are ignorant of.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain and his seed.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” The beloved is Israel: he “hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” It has been over three thousand years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. But “the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” That is the destiny of America and all nations.

“what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: our conversation must change. We see the signs, rivers dried up, presidents being stolen. We look for new heavens and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness, the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ, and we must be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless.

thread.label: Isaiah 49:5-6
thread.text: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.

precepts.label: Romans 10:14-15
precepts.why:
Isaiah says the Lord formed his servant from the womb “to bring Jacob again to him”, “to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel”, “that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.” That you may be a saviour. A lot of times we, the prophets, don’t understand the magnitude of our calling. The Lord said he would send us as saviours, and our people’s salvation will come no other way than by the prophets, the saviours God sent, and through his word. Paul shows why.

“How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard?” This shows the importance of the prophets, the saviours: there is no way for the people to be saved unless the saviours are sent. “and how shall they hear without a preacher? And how shall they preach, except they be sent?”

We have been sent, throughout the four corners of the earth, and from the beginning, to be saviours. By going forth and teaching God’s word, salvation comes here on earth. “as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace.”

That is why the prophets of God are “glorious in the eyes of the Lord.” There is no higher calling than being a prophet of the Most High God, once he has revealed his son in you at the appointed time. Some of us used to be athletes, and once Christ was awakened in us we let all that go. None of it compares to what we do now in these last days as watchmen of Israel. This is the true glory, glorious not to man but to God, and our God is our strength to raise up the tribes of Jacob.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 1:21
precepts.why:
Romans 10 asks, how shall they hear except they be sent? We have been sent to the four corners of the earth, sent from the beginning to be saviours, to “raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel.” And Paul shows the way God chose to do it: “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.”

Our people may see what we do as foolishness. Someone may say, I’ve just been called to do this to fold. No. God says it pleased him by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

That is our purpose. Preach God’s word. To be sent to preach God’s word, to save the believers, to save the elect. That is our goal and our mission, and you have to take pride in it.

So when Isaiah says the servant shall be “my salvation unto the end of the earth”, this is how: not by the wisdom of the world, which never knew God, but by the preaching of the prophets whom God formed from the womb and sent. Standing on the corner looking like a fool preaching his word is exactly what pleases him, and it is how Jacob is brought again to him.

They cannot bark: they will not prophesy and they will not warn you, like the dog that jumped out the window when its own owner pretended to break into the house.

Another said sow a seed of ten thousand and you'll be a millionaire overnight. All they speak about is prosperity: nothing about prophecy, nothing about warning you, nothing about getting your spirit right. Many don't even think they have a reason to bark, because they are too comfortable to see the danger right in front of them.

Here is one of the watchmen in action. Jamal Bryant, senior pastor of New Birth Missionary Baptist Church, preached with conviction that 85% of Jesus's life he was wrong and out of order, doing what he was not called to do, and the people sat there and listened to it.

The Bible says sin is the transgression of the law, the breaking and violating of God's laws. So was Christ wrong? Peter answers: “Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth.” He did no wrong at all.

Yet a pastor will get up and speak against Christ, and you never hear him speak against Babylon, America, never against homosexuality, never against the idolatrous festivals out here. That is the blind watchman, the dumb dog that cannot bark. So the prophets have to go out and proclaim among the Gentiles, “Prepare war”, and our own people need to know war is coming too.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 23:13-16
precepts.why:
When Ezekiel dug in the wall, he saw “every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.” That is like putting the images of Cesare Borgia on the walls, or Guadalupe on the walls, today. Ezekiel 23 shows what they were putting on the walls: images of the gods of their enemies.

“Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way, And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion, Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea”. Israel looked at the pictures of her enemies on the wall, dressed up like princes.

“And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.” As soon as she saw them, she wanted them. That is why the Lord said in Numbers 15, when he gave us the fringes, that with your eyes you will go a whoring.

Who is Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So the prophecy is against Esau-Edom, and the Lord says, “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

Why? “Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. The two nations are the northern kingdom, Ephraim, and the southern kingdom, Judah: they took those two nations by identity theft, robbing us of who we are. The two countries are the United States of America and Israel. The children of Israel were in both first, and the whole world was made for our sake, but Edom stole both lands.

They said, “and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there”. They possess it as if the Lord were with them, by calling themselves Jews and Christians. So “I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” The same way they hate the Israelites, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, the Lord will use that same anger against them, and they will know that God did it.

thread.label: Ezekiel 35:2

precepts.label: Genesis 36:8
precepts.why:
Moses settles who Mount Seir is: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So when the Lord tells Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,” the prophecy is against Esau, Edom. “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee” means God is against Esau-Edom.

Mount Seir itself is the place called Petra today, and nobody lives there. It is a rock with the same Roman-style structures you see on courthouses in America. God is not prophesying against a rock. He is prophesying against the people who once lived there, wherever they have gone. “I will lay thy cities waste” speaks of the other cities Esau-Edom built, which God still calls Mount Seir. “I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys” means wherever Edom is, his great governments and his smaller ones.

Then God gives the reason: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”. Perpetual means everlasting. Our people ask why white folks hate us so, when we never did anything to them. God answers: they have always hated us, because that is how he made them. We thought our iniquity had an end at the so-called emancipation, and Edom made a new thing, the KKK, whose hoods, crosses and cross-burning came out of Spain and the Spanish Inquisition, when they were murdering black people, the Jews. Look at the capirotes of Spain and the KKK: the same damn thing, the same damn group. The whites from Spain brought that dress code to America and terrorized Negroes, and Negroes ain't put one and one together yet. That is why calling Christianity white supremacy is literal.

So God has prepared him: “I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”, a violent life and a coming destruction. “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. And the boast that condemns him: “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. Those two nations are Judah and Israel, and the two countries are Israel and America: Edom took America as Christians and took the land of Israel as the Jews.

Ezekiel 36:5 makes it plain: God has spoken “against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say Japheth took the land; it says Idumea. So you're either going to go with what God said or what some negro on YouTube says. The Bible says Edom and their own scholars say Edom, so why are negroes going, no, it's Japheth? Esau put these things in his own books because he only expected his own people to read them. Their scholars agree: medieval chroniclers said Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, and Benjamin of Tudela called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, which is Christianity. This whole chapter reveals which race took the land of Israel and the land called America: Esau-Edom.

precepts.label: Revelation 2:9
precepts.why:

That is the blasphemy: Edom took over the land and said, it is given to us, we are the Jews. They are not the Jews, and the land is not theirs. Revelation 3:9 says it again: “I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie”. They are the devil the Bible speaks of, and it is the Son of God who said it.

The verse also speaks to our people: “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. That is our poverty, but we are rich, because we are the children of God.

“Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” By calling themselves Jews and claiming the land as Jews, Edom has boasted against God, and God heard every word. So “When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate”: when all creation is singing, Edom is destroyed. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”.

It was prophesied that the Messiah would come through Edom’s religion, Christianity, as a lord bent on doing away with all moral restraints: keep no commandments, keep no laws. That is the religion of Edom, and Christ is its enemy.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” He is telling you that many false prophets and many false Christs are going to rise. And it is happening: there are men online right now literally saying that they are Jesus. Freaking Jesus. Freak ass dude.

Christ said more in the same chapter: “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is going to happen, and those who are spiritually asleep will be the ones deceived.

So awaking out of sleep is guarding your mind from deception. The time is late, our salvation is nearer than when we believed, and the deceivers are already here. Take heed.

thread.label: Romans 15:4
thread.text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 5:42
precepts.why:
Solomon said, “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.” Paul says the same thing in different words: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”. Our learning today. There are no new incidents on this earth; everything that was done in the past is reoccurring.

Ezra shows it with a ring: “And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring”. A ring is like a circle. “like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first”. Slackness means slow: there is no slowness of the last judgments and no swiftness of the first. His judgments on the earth are a continual event that reoccurs over and over; it is the same thing.

That is why Paul said to comfort ourselves through what is written in the testimonies of the past: what we are living is a reoccurring event. To deal with these reoccurring events we must read the history and testimonies of our ancestors, “that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.”

We see it now. Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden image and gathered the rulers to its dedication, setting up a one world religion; today pastors gather to pray over and dedicate a towering gold statue of Donald Trump. What we read in Daniel 3 is coming to pass again, because the judgments go around like a ring.

precepts.label: Hosea 12:10
precepts.why:
The things written aforetime were written for our learning, and Hosea shows how they were written: “I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.”

All the prophets spoke: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Daniel, even Hosea. God multiplied visions, and he used similitudes, or parables, by the ministry of the prophets, comparing one thing to another.

That is how the scriptures teach us today. The past is a similitude of what is happening now, and by comparing one thing to another we can see our own time in what was written. The last beast of Revelation 13 is described with the leopard, the bear and the lion of Daniel 7: it carries the attributes of Greece, Persia and Media, and Babylon. The golden image of Daniel 3 stands again in our day.

So we read the prophets as similitudes, and through patience and comfort of the scriptures we have hope, because the Most High already showed in the past what he will do in the future.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 6:19-20
thread.text: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?

precepts.label: Proverbs 24:5
precepts.why:
“What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?” So you have to prepare ye war physically. This is war. Strengthen your body and keep it under control; you are not your own.

“A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.” A wise man is strong, and some of you brothers cannot do ten push-ups. Brothers get upset because the camp sets weight standards, and they can't run worth a damn thing; they cannot run three, four, five miles. Sisters, get in shape too. How the hell are you going to go out and teach when you are unfit?

A pastor once challenged the captain, fat as hell, saying he eats people like him up for dinner. Since he started with dinner, the answer was gluttony: about thirty scriptures of correction on his own church page. Not a debate about the color of Christ first; deal with your health right now.

Diets are not wrong, but you still have to exercise. You can fast seven days and be down ten or fifteen pounds, but the Lord put self-preservation in your DNA: the body goes into saving, starts storing more water and more fat, and it comes back. You have to get out here and work out. You are not getting any younger, and your body is the temple: you must be fit to serve.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 14:33
precepts.why:
“For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.” Your body is the temple, and you must be fit to serve; you cannot serve the Lord and be unfit.

Paul also says: “For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.” Prepare ye war physically, and keep your house in order, because God is not the author of confusion, and order protects in a crisis.

When this empire collapses and global trade is disrupted, the ones who are ready will be the ones whose bodies are strong and whose houses are in order. A body kept under control and a house kept in order is how we glorify God in the body he bought with a price.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 10:14
thread.text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

precepts.label: Exodus 20:3-5
precepts.why:
“Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry”. That is in the New Testament, for you black Christians, you black apologists, you black pastors who say the law is done away with. Why would Paul write it if the law was done away? Because it goes right back to Exodus 20: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me”.

“Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”. That is where 1 Corinthians 10:14 comes from.

Valentine's Day is idolatry; its origin is Februus and Lupercalia, a fertility rite in which women presented themselves to be struck because it was believed to help with fertility. When you sit up there and celebrate Valentine's Day, you are putting Februus, whoever the hell that is, and Lupercalia before the Lord. What's wrong with Christmas? It's idolatry. Your birthday? Idolatry. Halloween? Idolatry. That's what's wrong with it.

The Lord gave us our own high holy days, in Leviticus 23. The Destruction of Nicanor began last night at sundown, the victory recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14 and 15, when Judas Maccabeus defeated and killed Nicanor, the Seleucid Syrian Greek commander who came to crush Israel and threaten the temple. Tonight at sundown begins Purim, when we were saved from being wiped out in the Persian Empire: the enemy was Haman, and the deliverance came through Esther and Mordecai. Our enemies' holidays, the Fourth of July and Christmas, are victories over us. Ours are victories over our enemies. Flee from their idolatry and keep what the Lord gave us.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 11:3
thread.text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

precepts.label: John 5:30
precepts.why:
“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.” Is anybody confused on the order? Then why are there so many problems in Israel, so much confusion about the husband's position and the wife's position? Because pride has made its way in, and confusion has set itself in the house.

“and the head of Christ is God”. Was Christ ever confused, at any moment in his life, about his position and role with the Father? He said: “I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.”

Christ said, I am doing exactly as the Father told me to do. Is he doing what he wants? No. Christ understands his role and his position. And Christ now tells us the husband is the head of the wife. So why is there still so much confusion? Somebody does not believe like they say they do.

It happens on both sides of the room. Brother, because of your lack of leadership, because you are non-confrontational and passive and don't want no smoke, she raises her voice and you cower; she walks by shoulder-bumping you, and you can't raise your voice in your own house. All because you gave up your position. Some brothers want to be mama's boys: you didn't want a wife, you wanted a mom. If Christ submits to the head over him, the husband must take his place under Christ, and the wife her place under her husband.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 11:18-19
thread.text: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:1-3
thread.text: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 5:15
precepts.why:
Paul opens, “Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.” Sirach says the same: “Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.” You have to learn this and understand it, in the great matters as well as the small.

Do not be ignorant in the functionings of this body. It is essential to understand how the body works: you have to realize what every individual is worth. Nobody is above this. You are special because you are part of the body, but do not think you are more than another part. We are all one, working towards the same goal, and we have to do exactly what the Lord told us to do to get where we need to get.

It is easy to come in, sit down, and think everybody is just doing what they do. But understand how intricate this thing is, how many different offices there are in this body. Some came in, got patted down, dropped the kids off, and did not think twice about how much goes into dealing with those children. Some will get a plate of food brought to them and have no idea how many hands were involved to make that plate possible. There are people with gifts to deal with things you do not even have to think about. Be not ignorant of that.

precepts.label: Romans 12:2
precepts.why:
To be not ignorant, Paul tells the Romans: “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind”. When you come into this truth you are supposed to transform the way you think. The scriptures are supposed to be inside you now, and you have to apply them.

And why? “that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.” To prove means you are not ignorant. It is the ability to process, to identify, to differentiate. Your antennas are up now, and you will not be ignorant in anything any longer.

You were ignorant in the church. You were dumb as hell, stupid, knowing nothing, just walking along the line doing what everybody was doing: it is Christmas time, it is somebody's birthday, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, and never asking why. But now you are different. Now it has to make sense: what does the scripture say, where is that in the Bible? That is proving what is acceptable unto the Most High God, his perfect will.

precepts.label: Psalms 40:8
precepts.why:
What is the will of the Lord? David answers: “I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.” The will of God is the laws of God, and they are within the heart.

That is what a renewed mind does with them: it moves by them, processes, understands, knows, sees clearly. You have understanding now, and you are bouncing things off of the scriptures.

So you no longer conform to this world. You do not move like everybody else anymore. You are using your mind for what it is for: to delight in doing the will of God, with his law written within your heart. That is the opposite of the ignorance Paul warned the Corinthians about when he wrote, “I would not have you ignorant.”

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 12:13
precepts.why:
You have one job on this earth, and you have been given a mind to do that job. Solomon gives it: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” One duty.

You have a brain to understand how to fear God. You have a brain to understand what the commandments of God are. You have a brain to apply the laws of God in your life. That is why you have a mind. Congratulations: you know the meaning of life now.

If you are doing anything else with your mind, you missed. You are on that broad road to destruction. You cannot fill your mind with kill moves on Mortal Kombat, the moves on the PlayStation, the stats of Kobe and whether the NBA finals are over. We don't give a damn about none of that. Fill your mind with thus saith the Lord. Apply it to what is necessary in life: How do I deal with my wife? How do I deal with my kids? What can I do to become stronger, a better asset in this truth, so the Lord can use me? That is what we are supposed to be concerned with. If you are concerned with something else, maybe this ain't you.

precepts.label: Matthew 6:19-21
precepts.why:
Following what the Deacon brought out, Christ says: “For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.” Wherever your treasure is, that is where your mind is going to be occupied.

If your mind is filled with Mortal Kombat moves and the stats of the greatest to ever play any sport, that is where your focus is and that is where you are building up your treasures. “Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal”. All of those carnal things are going to be destroyed, so that should not be where your focus is.

“But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt”. When you occupy your mind in the laws of God, that is where you are laying up your treasure: how to unify, how can I be used as a tool for the Lord's army, how can I be utilized to push this truth further. That is where our minds should be: on treasure that cannot be corrupted, that no rust or moth can touch.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:2
thread.text: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

classes.title: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

precepts.label: Habakkuk 2:18-19
precepts.why:
“Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.” Why does Paul bring this up before he goes over the order of the body? Because they were not accustomed to godly order or sound doctrine. They were following dumb idols, doing what those idols wanted instead of what the Most High God wanted. He tells the Ephesians the same: “remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh”. That was us too: Hellenized, living like heathens.

Think about the mind frame of a person that follows idols. Habakkuk: “What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?” Somebody created this thing, formed it, and then turned around and said this is God, this is what brought you out of Egypt. You know how dumb you have to be? You stupid.

“Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach!” Woe is destruction: destruction to him that says to the wooden idol, wake up, and to the dumb stone, arise. You are on a highway to hell, a fast track to destruction, following dumb idols.

That is why Paul reminds them of the mindset they came from: to teach organization to a Hellenized Jew is extremely difficult. You have to let them know, that is not us anymore. As Romans 12 says, you have to renew your mind. We do not conduct ourselves like that any longer; now we learn the order of the body of Christ.

precepts.label: 1 John 5:21
precepts.why:
Paul reminds the Corinthians where they came from: “Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.” John gives the charge that goes with it: “Little children, keep yourselves from idols.” Stay the heck away from them. Stay away from it.

This was us. Esau's successful mission was to make our nation forget the laws of God and change the ordinances, to take away our heritage and make us become something we are not. They created that mind frame here, and you see it amongst our people.

Once you come into the truth you are supposed to go ten times harder and repent, not go back to the idols you were carried away to. Habakkuk showed where the idol worshipper ends up: destruction, speaking to wood and dumb stone that cannot teach.

So Paul clears away the old idol mindset before he teaches the diversities of gifts, administrations and operations in the one body. Keep yourselves from idols, renew your mind, and you can learn the godly order the Most High set in his body.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:4-6
thread.text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:7-11
thread.text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 4:10
precepts.why:
“But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.” Everyone has a gift, but it goes toward the same goal in unison. It is not just for you. However the manifestation comes, there are different gifts given so that you can profit with all the nation.

Peter: “As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.” Where does the gift come from? The Lord. And what is it used for? To minister one to another.

You have not been given a gift just for you. If you have been given a gift and you only use it for yourself, it did not come from the Lord; it is not of the Lord. You are supposed to use that gift to benefit your nation and your people. That is why you were given it. If your gift only glorifies you, it is not about Christ; it is about you.

“as good stewards”: now you understand the stewardship program. These gifts are to be used for the building of the body, so that we can do what we need to do as a nation. The word of wisdom, the word of knowledge, faith, all given “to every man to profit withal.”

precepts.label: Philippians 2:4
precepts.why:
When you have these gifts, what do you do with them? Paul: “Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.” How can I apply this gift to help somebody? How can I use what I know to help somebody else, to benefit my people, to benefit the school? What little brick can I put in that is going to bring us to where we need to be? That is the mind frame we must have when we function as a body.

Take the gift of reaching people. Some brothers can get a flyer into anybody's hand, even people who do not want one. The man walks off from one brother and tells him to go screw himself, and then another brother walks up the same way and the man leaves with a flyer in his hand saying, all right brothers, y'all take care. People have different gifts.

You might have used that gift in the world to hustle and get over on people, but that is not why you were given it. When you come into this truth and your mind is renewed, you understand: God gave me that gift so I can get the word out, relate to people, and show them thus saith the Lord.

If you are not using that gift for the Lord, the Lord did not give it to you; Satan gave it to you. God gives these gifts with purpose, “to profit withal”: every man looking on the things of others.

precepts.label: Romans 12:6-8
precepts.why:
“Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith”. These are the different gifts, administrations and operations. Whatever gift you have been given, if it is prophecy, prophesy with everything you have; whatever the Lord gave you, that is what you give.

“Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching”. Everybody stays in their lane. You work within the gift and skill set you have been given, and you do not try to force things that are not you. Size is not everything, but at camp you cannot put the brother who is 105 pounds at the front sentry. He might be the fire teacher, or real good on flyers, but if the wind blows it will carry him away and we will not have a front sentry.

When you are outside of your character, things get messy. If you pretend to be something you are not, you may be put in that position, and the person who should be there cannot operate the way the body needs, and we lack in different areas. Years ago a certain brother was put over the bills; one Sabbath the lights were off at the school. We learned that day he is not the one to put over the bills. We found where he belongs, and he is operating within his place now. Everybody does not belong everywhere.

“Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.” Everyone in their office, in their proper position. That is what Paul means when he says the one Spirit is “dividing to every man severally as he will.”

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:12-13
thread.text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 1:10
precepts.why:
“For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.” Precepts were called for from the brothers, and the first was Paul's own plea to the same Corinthians: “Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you”.

That fits the body. The members are many, but they speak the same thing, and there are no divisions among them. Diversity does not mean division: a different administration, dealing with something you don't deal with, is not separate from you. And different roles do not mean inequality; no function or operation in the body is unneeded.

That is why, wherever you travel among us, it should carry the same teachings: we are one body, in one mind, speaking the same thing. It all goes back to endeavouring to keep the unity, until we all come “unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ”.

precepts.label: Colossians 2:19
precepts.why:
The body is one and has many members, “so also is Christ.” Another brother brought Colossians: “And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.” It takes some explaining, but it speaks to the same thing.

The body is held together from the Head, Christ. From him the whole body, joined and banded together, has nourishment ministered to it and is knit together, and so it increases with the increase of God. The members do not hold themselves together; they are knit together by holding the Head.

That is the unity of the body: every joint and band ministering what it has been given, all fastened to the Head. Not holding the Head is how a body falls apart, and holding him is how it grows. That is why the next scriptures read go straight to Christ as the head of the body, the church.

precepts.label: Ephesians 1:22-23
precepts.why:
“so also is Christ”. How is the body Christ? Ephesians: “And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church, Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.”

God put all things under Christ's feet and gave him to be the head over all things to the church. Who is the head? Christ. Who is the body? The church. And who is the church? Us.

So when Paul says the many members are one body, “so also is Christ”, he means that we, the members, are his body, and he is the head over all of it. That is why there can be no division in the body: every member belongs to the same head, and the body is “the fulness of him that filleth all in all.”

precepts.label: Colossians 1:17-18
precepts.why:
Christ is the head of the body. Colossians: “And he is before all things, and by him all things consist. And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.”

Christ is before all things, and by him all things consist; everything holds together in him. He is the head of the body, the church, which is us. He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead.

“that in all things he might have the preeminence”. The many members, with their different gifts, administrations and operations, are one body because they all come under one head, and he has the first place in everything. Make sure those precepts are written down: the body of 1 Corinthians 12 is the church, and Christ is its head.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 20:30-31
precepts.why:
The body has many members, and the different administrations in it are all to endeavour to keep the unity. So when we have these different administrations, we should not hide or neglect them. Sirach: “Wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?”

That goes into wisdom, but also into the gift, because the wisdom God gives you comes through those gifts and through the spirit God puts on you. What profit is there in hiding wisdom or hoarding treasure? None. There is no profit in hiding the gift or the administration God has set you in and given you.

“Better is he that hideth his folly than a man that hideth his wisdom.” A man who hides his folly is better than one who hides his wisdom, who hoards up the understanding God has given him. If you know you are good at something and God has blessed you with that spirit, use it to keep pushing the truth and growing the unity God has called us to, because we are all one body and it all goes to the same Spirit.

precepts.label: Matthew 3:11
precepts.why:
“For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body”. How many of us were dunked in water, the Baptist way? A church baptism in a green, filthy pond was shown, the brothers joking that it was pickle juice, but this verse is not talking about that. Baptized means cleanse. Write that down and look it up yourself: baptized does not automatically mean dipped in water, which is what a lot of Southern Baptists think.

John says: “I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance”. If baptism always meant water, why would he need to say, I baptize you with water? It means, I cleanse you with water unto repentance. That was John's administration, water baptism, a tool to show forth repentance. It was never a requirement for the kingdom of heaven.

“but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear”. Somebody far mightier is coming, whose shoes John is not even worthy to hold. “he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire”. Did you hear anything about water? No. The baptism we must come under is through Christ: by one Spirit we are all cleansed into one body.

precepts.label: Luke 3:16-17
precepts.why:
Luke says the same thing, just in case anybody relapsed and wants to jump in the pickle juice: “I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire”. This is not talking about water.

“Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.” That is talking about judgment.

So you want the baptism of the Spirit, because the fire is coming to clean up everything else, and that is what Christ is coming with. The one Spirit that baptizes us into one body is the cleansing that gathers the wheat into his garner; the chaff that refuses it will be burned with fire unquenchable.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:14-18
thread.text: For the body is not one member, but many.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 12:21-25
thread.text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

thread.label: 1 Corinthians 14:33-34
thread.text: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

precepts.label: Acts 19:1-34
precepts.why:
“For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints. Let your women keep silence in the churches”. Why does that follow right after God is not the author of confusion? Because a woman speaking out of turn concerning the church is confusion. A woman not being in order is confusion.

There is history behind why Paul said to let the women keep silence in the churches. Acts 19: “And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus”. This is what was happening in that whole region of Corinth and Ephesus.

The craftsmen feared “that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.” Who were they worshipping? The great goddess Diana. And when they knew Paul was a Jew, “all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.”

That goddess worship ran through Corinth and that whole area. Some of those women repented, so to speak, came into the church, and brought that goddess spirit with them. That whole feminist movement is the same spirit, back today, and sisters do not want to admit that is the spirit they are rolling in. Feminism has been normalized to where a man has to whisper in his own house.

So when there are issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach: you let feminism and pride in and did not stop them at the door. If you are scared of your wife, brother, take the purple shirt off; you cannot cast down the lies of the nations and bring us out of captivity if you are scared to deal with your wife at home. precepts.label: Psalms 96:5
precepts.why:
The third brother, when they came to cut him, put out his tongue right away and held forth his hands manfully: come on, let's get this over with. He said courageously, “These I had from heaven; and for his laws I despise them; and from him I hope to receive them again.” And “the king, and they that were with him, marvelled at the young man's courage, for that he nothing regarded the pains.”

Why did they marvel? They had to understand there was a certain spirit in these brothers; there was something the brothers knew that the king did not. The psalm tells what it is: “For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.”

All the gods of the nations are idols, so the nations have no living God. The king had power, arrogance and the fire, but his gods were dead. These brothers served the Lord that made the heavens, the God who gave them their tongues and hands and would give them again. That is why they were ready to die rather than transgress the laws of their fathers, and why the heathen could only stand there and marvel.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 8:5-6
precepts.why:
The king marveled at the young man's courage, and Paul shows the reason. “For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,) But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.”

Because we understand that there is only one living God, that is why they marvel. That is why the king was marveling. The nations have gods many and lords many, but a man who knows the one God, the Father, and the one Lord Jesus Christ can say, “we are ready to die, rather than to transgress the laws of our fathers.”

Do you know what level of faith that is? You truly cannot desire anything left in this world. We are already captives: you have bills, you work fourteen hours a day. What are you leaving? There has to be something better. So the brothers went to the fire expecting “the King of the world” to raise them up “unto everlasting life”, and the fourth told the king, “as for thee, thou shalt have no resurrection to life.”

That hope belongs to those who have the one God. What kind of mercy would it be for the same people that torment us to get an equal reward in the kingdom? That is not a merciful God. The one God of Israel will of his own mercy give his servants breath and life again.
